string.name: setup_welcome
string.description: Spoken when the setup screen first shows

resources.string: Welcome. To use your glasses, this app needs to connect to the Meta AI app once. Say connect to start, or say help.

string.name: setup_welcome_no_mic
string.description: Spoken when the setup screen shows and the microphone permission is off

resources.string: Welcome. To use your glasses, this app needs to connect to the Meta AI app once. The microphone is off for this app, so I can\'t hear you. To talk to the app, open Android Settings, then Apps, HSTN Bench, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow. Or use the Connect my glasses button at the bottom of the screen.

string.name: setup_welcome_no_bluetooth
string.description: Spoken when the setup screen shows and the nearby devices permission is off

resources.string: Welcome. This app can\'t reach your glasses yet, because the Nearby devices permission is off. Say connect to fix it, or say help.

string.name: setup_tool_first
string.description: Said before the welcome when a tool was opened by voice before setup; %1$s is the tool name

resources.string: %1$s needs a one-time setup first.

string.name: setup_resumed
string.description: Spoken when the user comes back to the setup screen

resources.string: Glasses setup. Say connect to start, or say help.

string.name: setup_help
string.description: Spoken help on the setup screen

resources.string: This is the setup screen. Before it can use your glasses, this app needs a one-time connection with the Meta AI app. You can say: connect, to open Meta AI and approve it. Repeat, to hear the last thing again. Open settings, for this app\'s permissions. Or close the app. The Connect my glasses button at the bottom of the screen does the same as saying connect.

string.name: setup_handoff
string.description: Spoken just before opening Meta AI for registration

resources.string: Opening Meta AI. Approve the connection there, then come back.

string.name: setup_not_connected_yet
string.description: Spoken on return from Meta AI when the app still isn't registered

resources.string: You\'re back, but the app isn\'t connected to your glasses yet. Say connect to try again, or say help.

string.name: setup_didnt_open
string.description: Spoken when Meta AI did not open after asking to connect

resources.string: Meta AI didn\'t open, or the connection didn\'t finish. Check the Meta AI app is installed and your glasses are paired in it. Say connect to try again, or say help.

string.name: setup_declined
string.description: Spoken when the user says no or not now

resources.string: Okay. Say connect when you\'re ready, or say close the app.

string.name: setup_not_understood
string.description: Spoken when a short phrase wasn't understood

resources.string: Sorry, I didn\'t get that. Say connect, or say help.

string.name: setup_reminder
string.description: Reminder after a quiet stretch

resources.string: I\'m still here. Say connect to set up your glasses, or say help.

string.name: setup_last_reminder
string.description: Final reminder; the app then stays quiet

resources.string: I\'ll stop reminding you now. Say connect whenever you\'re ready, or use the Connect my glasses button.

string.name: setup_goodbye
string.description: Spoken before the app moves to the background

resources.string: Closing. Open the app again whenever you\'re ready.

string.name: setup_opening_settings
string.description: Spoken before opening this app's Android settings

resources.string: Opening this app\'s settings. Choose Permissions to change the microphone or Nearby devices.

string.name: setup_needs_bluetooth_ask
string.description: Spoken before asking for nearby devices permission again

resources.string: First the app needs the Nearby devices permission, to reach your glasses. Android will ask now. Choose Allow.

string.name: setup_needs_bluetooth_settings
string.description: Spoken when nearby devices permission is permanently denied

resources.string: The Nearby devices permission is off, and Android won\'t ask again. Say open settings, then choose Permissions, Nearby devices, and Allow.

string.name: setup_already_connecting
string.description: Spoken when connect is said while registration is under way

resources.string: Already connecting. Approve the connection in Meta AI, then come back.

string.name: setup_ask_mic
string.description: Spoken before the microphone permission dialog

resources.string: Android will ask to use the microphone so you can talk to the app. Choose Allow.

string.name: setup_ask_bluetooth
string.description: Spoken before the nearby devices permission dialog

resources.string: Android will ask to find and connect to nearby devices, so the app can reach your glasses. Choose Allow.

string.name: setup_ask_both
string.description: Spoken before the nearby devices and microphone permission dialogs

resources.string: Android will ask two things. First, to connect to nearby devices, so the app can reach your glasses. Then, to use the microphone, so you can talk to the app. Choose Allow both times.

string.name: setup_bluetooth_denied
string.description: Error when the nearby devices permission is denied

resources.string: The Nearby devices permission is off, so the app can\'t reach your glasses. Say connect to be asked again, or open Android Settings, Apps, HSTN Bench, Permissions, Nearby devices, and choose Allow.

string.name: setup_connect_description
string.description: TalkBack description of the connect button

resources.string: Connect my glasses. Opens the Meta AI app to approve the connection, then come back here.

string.name: setup_status_listening
string.description: On-screen voice status while listening

resources.string: Listening. Say connect, or say help.

string.name: setup_status_speaking
string.description: On-screen voice status while speaking

resources.string: Speaking…

string.name: setup_status_no_mic
string.description: On-screen voice status when the microphone is off

resources.string: Microphone off. Use the button, or allow the microphone in Settings.

string.name: setup_status_off
string.description: On-screen voice status when not listening

resources.string: Voice is off.

string.name: setup_heard_label
string.description: Label before the last phrase the setup screen heard

resources.string: Heard
